attestations.note: The life page heads «Τύπος εορτής: Σταθερή. Εορτάζει στις 3 Νοεμβρίου εκάστου έτους», the same day as the listing, and the whole notice is one sentence. The entry enumerates five, each with a heading, so it is five folders; the page's epigram makes this one the woman of the company, «Σύμμαρτυς ἔστω καὶ γυνὴ τοῖς ἀνδράσι». The corpus's «theodote-companion-of-theodotus» is a different pair on a different day. No `dates` object, no location. No hymn. No asterisk and not the sentence «Δεν είναι διασταυρωμένη η ύπαρξη του Αγίου».
